response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), t AS (SELECT archstat, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT archstat, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM t) SELECT archstat, cnt AS record_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share
